Last updated: January 2025

Welcome to School App (brijbymgt). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you as to how we look after your personal data when you visit our application and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
• Personal Identifiable Information: Full name, email address, and mobile number provided during registration.
• School & Student Records: Student details, exam marks, health records, notes, and attendance data entered locally or synced.
• Device Information: Device state, logs, and crash reports for app stability.

2. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
• To manage user authentication and session security via OTP verification.
• To provide school administration features including student management, report cards, and exam records.
• To communicate important service updates and security notices.

3. DATA SECURITY & RETENTION
We implement robust technical and organizational security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or alteration. Data is stored securely in encrypted local databases and authorized cloud sessions.

4. YOUR PRIVACY RIGHTS
You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data at any time through account settings or by contacting support.

5. CONTACT US
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@brijbymgt.com.
